2026-09-28 13:38:37.255436 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255440 | controller |
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255444 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255448 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255451 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255454 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 13:38:37.255458 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
